title: Jesse visits the Richter island site at Bariloche

tellings.quote: Yeah, I've been there actually. I've seen it. A little island off the off the coast of Baroce.

plain: There is a small island just off the coast near Bariloche, a town in Argentina, tied to a scientist named Ronald Richter, and Jesse Michels says he has been there and seen it himself. He mentions it in passing, "a little island off the coast", while talking with the researcher Jason Jorjani about claims of a secret Nazi flying-saucer effort. For Michels it is a real place he can vouch for in a story that otherwise lives in old records.
